name: PNC Cash Unlimited Visa Credit Card

localized_names.en: PNC Cash Unlimited Visa Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 90 days of account opening, then a variable APR of 18.74% to 28.74%.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 2% cash back on every purchase.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem as a statement credit or a deposit into an eligible PNC account.

notes: The product page names the card PNC Cash Unlimited Visa and mentions Visa Signature only in a trademark footer, so network_tier is none.
